recent.text: Kevin Durant had a good look at a potential game-tying 3-pointer and it came up just short. Rockets are gonna leave Phoenix with their 3rd loss of the season. Devin Booker's late-game shot-making was just too much to overcome.

recent.text: Fred VanVleet just picked up his 4th foul with 7:42 left in the 3rd. That's a big one for Houston. FVV has been on fire tonight. He leads all scorers with 16 points. Marcus Smart will sub in for him at point guard.

recent.text: Would like to see Alperen Sengun respond after a rough first half that ended with him being benched for the final 10 minutes of the 2nd quarter. He went into halftime with 2 points on 1-6 shooting with 1 rebounds and 2 assists. He should be dominating these Phoenix bigs.

recent.text: Coming into this season, Kevin Durant attempted one or fewer shots over an entire half only 9 times in his career. He's already done it twice in Houston's first 10 games this season.
